concept.hr: Posuđivanje ili jednaki dodaci: razlika ostaje ista, pa je i rezultat isti
concept.en: Borrowing or equal additions: the difference stays, so the answer is the same

summary.hr: Upiši dva broja i oduzimaj na dva načina odjednom: posuđivanjem i jednakim dodacima, s nulom u umanjeniku, u bilo kojoj bazi od 2 do 16.
summary.en: Type two numbers and subtract both ways at once, borrowing and equal additions, with a zero on top, in any base from 2 to 16.

concept.hr: Posudba prolazi kroz svaku nulu; jednaki dodaci samo dodaju
concept.en: A borrow passes through every zero; equal additions only add
The same methods: a borrowed one is worth 2
